text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono is always cooking meals for me,
so isn't there something nice I could treat her to in return?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that thought in mind, I head to the shopping mall—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer!
What a coincidence~ Are you out shopping too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I was checking out the deli dishes and sweets~
Thought I'd pick up anything new that caught my eye!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I went with macarons today!
Raspberry flavored, and I actually just ate them in the rest area ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
They were truly buono, so I immediately sent
a photo and a review to my mom and dad~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I find something new,
I always send it over to those two~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Both my dad and mom are chefs, you see,
so they absolutely love hearing about it.
choice_data_list: You mentioned before that your parents taught you how to cook...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yep, exactly! My dad's an Italian chef,
and my mom's a pastry chef~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So while I love cooking food myself,
I also super-duper love hunting down tasty treats!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono looks genuinely thrilled.
Treating her to a home-cooked meal would definitely be the best choice.
choice_data_list: Hishi Akebono, is there anything you'd like to eat?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? What brought this on all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~? You don't need to do that to thank me!
As long as you leave full and satisfied, I'm happy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you eat my food with that big smile,
it brings me so much pure happiness.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It makes my chest feel all warm and fuzzy...
It's kind of hard to put into words, though~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, so you really don't have to repay me ☆
choice_data_list: But I can't just keep being on the receiving end...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case, I'll cook dinner tonight too,
and you can just enjoy eating it as much as always!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty ☆ Let's go buy some ingredients!
The shopping street's definitely better for fresh groceries.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make a whole big feast~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of making chicken mizutaki today,
but maybe alongside that—

text_block_list.name: Child's Voice
text_block_list.text: Look! Sumo wrestlers!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Where, where?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the child's voice and gaze, we spot several sumo wrestlers
walking down the street, seemingly fresh off morning practice.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the real deal...!
Trainer, do you mind if I go talk to them?!
choice_data_list: Just don't bother them too much.
Just don't get in their way, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yep, of course!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Excuse meee~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono happily calls out to them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She peppers them with curious questions,
and the wrestlers gladly answer with warm smiles.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's what goes into chanko nabe...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm. Nutrient-packed chanko nabe
really is the secret to true strength, huh~

text_block_list.name: Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you got that right!
You can't build a body like this without chanko!

text_block_list.name: Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text:
Besides, chanko is a dish packed full of heart.
There's no way you wouldn't get strong eating it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Heart... as in wanting the person eating it to enjoy it, right!
I always pour tons of love into my cooking too!

text_block_list.name: Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text: Hold on now, that's only half of it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sumo Wrestler
text_block_list.text:
Only when the feelings of both the cook and the eater
are poured into the pot do you get true chanko! Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: True chanko...? The eater's... feelings?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, pouring in the feelings of the person eating it...
What does that even mean...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I mean, by the time they're eating, the food is already finished, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The eater's feelings... their heart, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What the wrestler meant was probably 'mutual gratitude.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The 'itadakimasu,' and the heartfelt gratitude behind it,
is what truly completes a dish.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
True chanko...
Trainer, do you know what he meant?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Give it a try?
choice_data_list: This time, I'll pour my heart into cooking something for you.
This time, I'll pour my heart into cooking something for you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...If you do that, maybe I'll figure it out?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! Okay, I got it!
I'll be counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the day we met when she saved my life, to all the times
she healed my body and soul with delicious food...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I need to pour all my gratitude into making this—!
